_meta.policy: Roadmap is execution order only; parity claims still require checklist dimensions to be complete.

overall.methodology: status-derived average across all services and dimensions

azureFunctionsDurable.methodology: status-derived base plus bounded evidence bonuses from local facade, provider behavior, data-plane status, and green parity pack

logicWorkflows.methodology: status-derived base plus bounded evidence bonuses from local facade, provider behavior, data-plane status, and green parity pack

crossCuttingBacklog.label: More live Azure capture expansion per service
crossCuttingBacklog.detail: Turn candidate control-plane and data-plane calls into cleanup-verified real Azure fixtures for every high-value service surface.
commands: npm run conformance:classify && npm run conformance:expectations

crossCuttingBacklog.label: More parameter variance beyond generic invalid/missing cases
crossCuttingBacklog.detail: Add service-specific invalid names, parent references, enum values, mutually-exclusive fields, range checks, and schema-shape captures before normalizing local behavior.
commands: npm run conformance:classify && npm run conformance:expectations

crossCuttingBacklog.label: Provider refresh, diff/preview, update, import, drift, and destroy semantics
crossCuttingBacklog.detail: Extend each platform runner beyond create/destroy smoke so generated IaC behaves the same way against GlobalStack as it does against Azure provider tooling.

crossCuttingBacklog.label: Exact error-shape and header fidelity
crossCuttingBacklog.detail: Match Azure status codes, error codes, body structure, async-operation headers, retry headers, and request-id shaped responses for captured cases.
commands: npm run conformance:classify && npm run conformance:expectations

crossCuttingBacklog.label: Retry and eventual-consistency behavior
crossCuttingBacklog.detail: Capture poll cadence, transitional states, delayed reads, delete lag, and retryable failures before claiming timing fidelity.
commands: npm run conformance:classify && npm run conformance:expectations

crossCuttingBacklog.label: RBAC and authorization behavior
crossCuttingBacklog.detail: Expand allow/deny matrices for ARM and service data planes, including propagation lag and inherited-scope behavior where Azure actually enforces it.

crossCuttingBacklog.label: Repeat captures for timing-sensitive behavior
crossCuttingBacklog.detail: Re-capture ambiguous or unstable Azure behavior before encoding it into local expectations, especially delete/read races and async completion windows.
commands: npm run conformance:classify && npm run conformance:expectations

crossCuttingBacklog.label: Deeper service-specific data planes where applicable
crossCuttingBacklog.detail: Broaden bounded local facades and official-emulator integrations for services such as Cosmos, Files, Event Hubs, App Configuration, Key Vault, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis.
